messages:
mia - sales: Hey @jess — quick sync: Acme needs ISO scope docs + pen-test letter for the POC contract. Can we confirm deadlines and what artifacts you need? cc @arjun @samir
jess - acme (customer): Thanks, Mia. We need: ISO 27001 scope (controls map), SOC 2 Type II evidence summary, signed pen-test letter confirming scheduled window and high-level test scope. Deadline: legal wants everything by Tue next week (2024-10-08). Is that feasible?
arjun - solutions: Thanks. Our standard pack is: scope doc, sysdiag network diagram, SOC2 evidence index (csv), sample pen-test letter template. For POC we can sanitize logs and provide short-term staging creds. Two Qs: 1) Do you need raw logs? 2) Are you ok with summarized control evidence?
samir - security: We don't hand over raw logs unless under NDA + justification. We can provide redacted logs and a CRO-signed attestation. Pen-test letter: we can sign an engagement confirmation that says 'no known critical vulns' only post-test. For scheduling: our pen-test partner needs 3 weeks lead time.
jess - acme (customer): Raw logs not necessary, summarized evidence ok. But legal insists on a signed pen-test letter stating 'assessment completed by external 3rd party' — can that be backdated if test in-progress?
olivia - ops: Not backdated. We can provide 'letter of intent' + test window dates, then final attestation after test. Workflow: 1) Letter of intent (we can sign) 2) Test runs 3) Final attestation.
mia - sales: :thumbsup: That sounds workable. Jess — will that satisfy Legal temporarily? If yes we'll send the letter of intent today.
jess - acme (customer): Yes, LOI accepted as interim. Legal still needs confirmation that Dedicated pricing won't change because of extra retention for audit logs. Any cost impact?
arjun - solutions: If they need 90-day extra retention on Dedicated, that's +10% on Dedicated monthly. For Hosted API it's more complicated (per-GB). I'll send a formal quote. For POC we can offer a temporary waiver (30 days) if they sign LOI and commit to Dedicated within 60 days.
mia - sales: Great — please put waiver in writing. Also need the exact list of artifacts we'll deliver so Legal can update checklist.
ci-bot: File uploaded: s3://redwood-assets/compliance/acme/poc-evidence-checklist-2024-10-03.csv by arjun
arjun - solutions: Uploaded checklist contains: control-mapping, sample-attestations, network-diagram, staging-creds-expiration, pen-test-template. Staging creds: will expire after 14 days; we will rotate keys.
jess - acme (customer): Can you mark which items require non-disclosure? we need to add to our internal redline.
samir - security: Items requiring NDA: redacted logs, staging creds, internal diag details. Everything else is customer-facing. We'll prepare NDA clause language.
mia - sales: I'll coordinate signatures. If all good I'll request LOI from legal and post here. Tentative timeline: LOI today, arrange pen-test window wk of 10/21, final attestation by 11/05. Anyone object?
jess - acme (customer): Sounds good. Please include the temporary pricing waiver in the LOI.
arjun - solutions: Noted. I'll attach quote + waiver to LOI draft.
olivia - ops: Ops will prepare staging env and retention settings — need 48 hours after LOI is signed.
mia - sales: Awesome. Thanks everyone. I'll post the LOI draft in this thread.
ci-bot: Message pinned: LOI draft uploaded to shared drive: https://drive.company/loi/acme-loi-draft-v1.docx
